scripts.clean: bun run --cwd packages/tui clean && bun run --cwd packages/ai clean && bun run --cwd packages/agent clean && bun run --cwd packages/coding-agent clean
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/tui build && bun run --cwd packages/ai build && bun run --cwd packages/agent build && bun run --cwd packages/coding-agent build
scripts.build:fresh: bun run --cwd packages/tui build && bun run --cwd packages/ai build:fresh && bun run --cwd packages/agent build && bun run --cwd packages/coding-agent build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && bun run check:pinned-deps && bun run check:ts-imports && tsgo --noEmit && bun run check:browser-smoke
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/tui test && bun run --cwd packages/ai test && bun run --cwd packages/agent test && bun run --cwd packages/coding-agent test
scripts.version:patch: node scripts/bump-workspace-version.mjs patch && node scripts/sync-versions.js && bun install
scripts.version:minor: node scripts/bump-workspace-version.mjs minor && node scripts/sync-versions.js && bun install
scripts.version:major: node scripts/bump-workspace-version.mjs major && node scripts/sync-versions.js && bun install
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build:fresh && bun run check
